items.prompt: Why do injected exception tests not prove a local shard store is durable and safe for concurrent workers?
items.modelAnswer: Exceptions are not process kill/power failure/filesystem loss;no fsync/directory durability tested. Existence-check/replace races with other writers and hostile paths are excluded. Need actual deployment/filesystem concurrency/recovery protocol and testing,plus batch manifest/identity/permission review. Atomic rename and content hash are limited guarantees.
